column1: # tmux_twins.tsv — #493 / PRD #475 task 6: the headless twin of every test that needs a real tmux.
# A test needs tmux when test/helpers.sh `tmux_needing_tests` finds it (it starts a pane or gates on the binary); on Windows
# there is no tmux, so each of them is paired here with a test on the headless session backend that asserts the same
# behaviour and runs there. test/test_tmux_twins.sh fails on a tmux test with no line, a stale line, and a twin that is
# missing, needs tmux itself, skips instead of asserting, or is not on the headless backend.
#   <twin> = a test file in test/ (headless backend, no tmux) | self:<row> (a headless-<row> cell of the same test_cli_matrix.sh,
#   which also stands in for its tmux cells on a host without tmux) | na:<matrix row> (the test skips through windows_skip on a
#   row that is n/a on Windows; none today — only swarm submission is n/a, and test_swarm.sh is no tmux test).
